heads.en: Two hundred and seventy thousand people are on the line to watch Cai English: You will be elected, you will speak less. Zai said, "I'm sure you'll succeed, and I think the mayor's head might be a little bit inappropriate." On the day of Thanksgiving, the east coast of the United States was hit by low air pressure, with winds in the interior reaching 80 km an hour, New Jersey declared an emergency, and New York's Mercer Thanksgiving parade was postponed.
